ops.text: A third option is the square-octagon variant of cultivation [⟦new.B1⟧], which reports $p_{m}=4.3\times 10^{-10}$ at essentially the same footprint per unit.
Because $N_{T}$ grows as $n^{5}$, lowering $p_{m}$ from $2\times 10^{-9}$ to the $4.3\times 10^{-10}$ of the square-octagon variant moves this limit from $n\approx 42$ to $n\approx 57$.

new_bib.text: O. Hedlund, E. Sandberg, J. Wiklund, and M. Forsgren, “Magic state cultivation in the square-octagon colour code,” (2026), preprint.
